title: Execution of straight-line statements
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ss$ be a finite list of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs, and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each input. The list of line values produced by running $ss$ on $x$ is obtained by starting with no line values and, in order, appending the Boolean value of each statement evaluated at $x$ using the line values already produced.
